mentions.name: Comic Strip Time Machine
mentions.description: A web toy that acts as a comic strip time machine, generating a virtual newspaper comics page for any date in the last seventy years so users can browse historic comic strips as they would have appeared in print.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just finished a little webtoy. It's like a comic strip time machine - you can see a virtual newspaper comics page for any date in the last seventy years.
